summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Shrimad Bhagavat Katha Mahotsav 2026 event website. All major functionalities are working correctly including homepage, registration form, admin panel, and backend APIs.
passed_tests: Homepage loads with all sections (hero, about, acharya, schedule, themes, venue, family, dedication, contact, footer)
Navbar with sticky behavior and navigation links work correctly
Hero section countdown timer showing days/hours/minutes/seconds
Register Now buttons navigate to /register page
Multi-step registration form - all 8 steps functional and navigable
Registration form submission to POST /api/registrations successful
Success page shown after form submission with proper messaging
Admin login page at /admin with email/password authentication
Admin dashboard shows summary cards and registrations table with real data
CSV export button works and downloads file successfully
Admin logout functionality working correctly
Backend API: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials (100% success)
Backend API: GET /api/auth/me returns authenticated user data
Backend API: POST /api/registrations creates registration successfully
Backend API: GET /api/admin/registrations returns registration list
Backend API: GET /api/admin/summary returns aggregated statistics
Backend API: GET /api/admin/export-csv returns CSV file with proper headers
Venue section has Google Maps embed working
Sound toggle button exists in navbar (visual functionality)
Sticky register button appears on scroll
Contact buttons (call and WhatsApp) are functional
Invalid login credentials show proper error messages
Unauthorized access to admin endpoints properly blocked (401 status)
